title: "Pseudowords"
subtitle: "Generated non-words for the LexTALE-style test: kept, rejected, and why"
page-layout: full

```{python}
import _lib as L
import itables
itables.init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=False, connected=True)

acc, rej = L.csv("pseudoslowa.csv"), L.csv("pseudoslowa_odrzucone.csv")
n = lambda v: L.fmt(int(v))
uni = acc[acc["metoda"] == "unipseudo"]
uni_broken = len(uni) > 0 and uni["pseudoslowo"].nunique() <= max(10, len(uni) // 10)
```

Templates are single real words from the general pool, stratified by length and syllable count. Each of the four
generators proposes pseudowords for a template; filters then reject anything that is, or looks too much like, a real
Polish word. `imbir` is a published ready-made list, sampled at random, so its rows are not derived from the
template they sit next to.

```{python}
rows = []
for m in sorted(set(acc["metoda"]) | set(rej["metoda"])):
    a, r = acc[acc["metoda"] == m], rej[rej["metoda"] == m]
    rows.append((f"`{m}`", len(a) + len(r), len(a), a["pseudoslowo"].nunique(), len(r)))
rows.append(("**all**", len(acc) + len(rej), len(acc), acc["pseudoslowo"].nunique(), len(rej)))
L.table(rows, ["Generator", "Generated", "Kept", "Kept, distinct strings", "Rejected"])
```

```{python}
if uni_broken:
    L.md(f"""::: {{.callout-warning title="The `unipseudo` rows of this run are not usable"}}
The {n(len(uni))} kept `unipseudo` rows are copies of {n(uni['pseudoslowo'].nunique())} strings
({", ".join(f"*{w}*" for w in uni['pseudoslowo'].unique()[:10])}), repeated for every template.
Step 7 starts the UniPseudo generator but does not read what it prints. It then takes the first rows of whichever CSV
file lies in `resources/pseudo/unipseudo/`, and in this run that was the six-letter smoke-test file. The strings are
therefore neither matched to their templates nor newly generated. Count
{n(acc[acc['metoda'] != 'unipseudo']['pseudoslowo'].nunique())} distinct pseudowords from the other three generators
as the usable result of this run. The step needs fixing before the full run.
:::""")
```

```{python}
L.source("pseudoslowa_odrzucone.csv")

front = ["szablon", "pseudoslowo", "metoda", "powod_odrzucenia"]
L.dt(rej[front + [c for c in rej.columns if c not in front]], page=50)
```

## Distributions

Mean and standard deviation of four surface features, templates (`prawdziwe`) against kept pseudowords
(`pseudoslowa`). Similar distributions mean a pupil cannot tell the two groups apart by length or spelling pattern
alone.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
d = pd.read_csv(L.OUT / "pseudoslowa_rozklady.csv", header=[0, 1], index_col=0)
d.columns = [f"{a} · {b}" for a, b in d.columns]
d = d.reset_index().rename(columns={d.index.name or "index": "group"})
L.source("pseudoslowa_rozklady.csv")
L.df_table(d)
by = acc.groupby("metoda")[["dlugosc", "syl", "zbitka", "diakryty", "old20"]].mean().round(3).reset_index()
L.md("Means by generator, kept rows (computed from `pseudoslowa.csv`):")
L.df_table(by)
```
